description_expanded:
Seacrest Beach

3 bedrooms, 3 baths

.4 miles from private beach access

100 steps to giant community resort pool and amphitheater

Complimentary community tram, to beach and back

3 bikes!

Gas grill

4-star restaurants

Fun eateries and boutiques

Sound Waves Getaways by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Freshly remodeled in 2023, this stylish Seacrest Beach home has plenty of space to stretch out, relax, and make yourself at home. It's tucked on a quiet street, with porches on every level and a peaceful backyard that feels like your own little hideaway. On the first floor, a primary bedroom with a private bath offers comfort and space to recharge. The open living area features all-new furniture, a dining table for 10, and a huge kitchen island with seating for four more. Upstairs, there’s a guest room with two queen beds and a spacious bathroom with a soaking tub and separate shower. A full porch off the room is perfect for morning coffee or a quiet escape. Down the hall, a fun bunk room features three XL twin bunks, its own bath, and another private porch overlooking the backyard. The third floor is a flexible space with a queen sleeper sofa, a desk, and a play area for kids.

Every bedroom opens to a porch, making it easy to enjoy the quiet outside. Outside, the private backyard is calm and leafy, with space to relax after a beach day. There’s an outdoor shower, walk-in laundry room, and parking for two cars. And the beach? Just a short walk or tram ride away! Enjoy. Oversee 30A is local and here when you need us, every day, with a 24/7 emergency line just in case. Overview: - (.4 mile) to beach (private access) - (.1 mile) to the resort pool and amphitheater (seasonal concerts) - Complimentary tram service to beach and back (March-October) - 3 bedroom, 3 bath - 2,254 Sq. Ft. - Wifi - Gas grill - 3 bikes included Overnight: FIRST FLOOR - Primary Bedroom: King bed, private bath, TV SECOND FLOOR - Guest Bedroom: Two queen beds, private bath, TV - Bunk Room: 6 twin XLs bunks, private bath, TV THIRD FLOOR - Queen sleeper sofa in living area Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Check-out is 10:00 AM CST.
